reads.why: Checks the UI's static files carry the headers the Worker would have given them.
Checks the UI's shell carries every link preview tag the Worker sets, with the site's own values.
Draws the bot cards with the bots' own pictures, as the Worker reads them from the built UI.
Checks the development server proxies the link preview images the Worker's router serves.
Checks the development server proxies the MCP and OAuth paths the Worker's router serves.
Bundles the Worker with the same gateway-only stubs as the app's edge build.
